The Required and Preferred subheadings set their respective defaults; the Preferred section adds no qualifying technical skills.
Excluded the explicitly requested enterprise domain expertise, including Cybersecurity and IAM, because the guide excludes domain knowledge.
Mapped coding fluency to software-engineering and generic security considerations to data-privacy-and-security tentatively; both mappings warrant review.
Treated integrations as covered by the APIs criterion, rather than adding workflow automation, which is not requested.
Kept data flows unmapped rather than inferring data pipelines or data modeling.
Technologies and practices mentioned only in responsibilities, company background, or benefits were excluded.
